items.summary: Recommendation: retain only zero-spend, reversible routing repairs with exact installed-owner alignment; reject revenue, margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, budget, and forecast claims. The 30-day Amazon window pulled 2026-10-02 reports 5.20 commission, 5,992 clicks, 31 ordered items, and 7 shipped items, but all commission is aggregate and unattributed; site revenue and contribution margin are unsupported. AI spend was $54.5828597 across 359 calls from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02, with 22 errors and only 28 of 40 expected sites instrumented. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because these routing changes have no period-aligned financial outcome and no labor-rate ledger. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly limits, infrastructure/domain costs, and labor costs are absent. Retain four routing-only changes that match the authoritative installed owner: 0daynews.com, arttogogh.com, eastcoastrappers.com, and reviewtattoo.com. Reject the americastrikes.com and totaljerks.com requests as assigned to engineer despite authoritative expected owners news-writer and guide-writer. Minimum finance measurement remains a period-aligned ledger linking each site/action to provider revenue, AI cost, infrastructure/domain cost, labor cost, and attributable outcome; until then, do not claim revenue, ROI, contribution margin, causal lift, or forecasted upside.
